title: Model Cascade Streaming — ADR-001 TRIZ Principles 10 + 24

stream_cascade.approach: Daemon thread for slow model (120B), threading.Event for switch signal, queue.Queue for token buffer (thread-safe)
stream_cascade.dispatch: stream() auto-dispatches to stream_cascade() when cascade_model_name is set — transparent to callers

engine_config.get_llm_backend: cascade=True parameter (default); cascade=False for research/high-quality mode

triz_resolution.contradiction: C4 — TTFT (Speed, P9) vs Generation Quality (P12)
triz_resolution.elimination: Both sides now win: TTFT <5s from mini-4b AND 120B quality at stanza end

timeline_spec.t0s: Request arrives; BOTH models start simultaneously
timeline_spec.t5s: Client sees first lyric line (TTFT target met)
timeline_spec.t65s: nemotron-3-super:120b content tokens begin — stream switches
timeline_spec.t80s: Client receives full high-quality stanza from 120B

fallbacks.slow_timeout: If 120B content does not arrive within 120s, fast-model output used as final
fallbacks.slow_error: If 120B errors, daemon thread sets sentinel, no exception propagated
fallbacks.no_cascade: If cascade_model_name=None, stream() falls through to plain _http_stream (research mode)

gate_metric_spec.note: Live metric verification requires Ollama running with both models; validated structurally via tests
